# Pull Request Templates

This repository provides multiple PR templates for different types of changes. When creating a pull request, you can select the most appropriate template:

## Available Templates

### 🔗 How to Use Templates

Add the template parameter to your PR URL:

#### 1. Documentation Updates (Default)

**URL:** `https://github.com/Dannorj/wiki-test/compare/main...your-branch?template=documentation.md`

Use for:

- Adding new documentation
- Updating existing docs
- Reorganizing content
- Fixing documentation issues

#### 2. Bug Fixes

**URL:** `https://github.com/Dannorj/wiki-test/compare/main...your-branch?template=bugfix.md`

Use for:

- Fixing broken links
- Correcting errors
- Resolving issues

#### 3. New Features

**URL:** `https://github.com/Dannorj/wiki-test/compare/main...your-branch?template=feature.md`

Use for:

- Adding new sections
- Implementing new functionality
- Major structural changes

## Quick Links

When you're ready to create a PR, use these direct links:

- [📚 Documentation Update](../../compare/main...new-branch?template=documentation.md)
- [🐛 Bug Fix](../../compare/main...new-branch?template=bugfix.md)
- [✨ New Feature](../../compare/main...new-branch?template=feature.md)
- [🧪 My Template](../../compare/main...new-branch?template=pull_request_template.md)

> **Note:** Replace `new-branch` with your actual branch name in the URLs above.
